reviewer_scope: Independent lightweight consistency audit; no live DB, browser, build, or runtime checks.

verdict_a.basis: All 169 canonical inventory entries whose surface is exactly “Tools / registered executor” are represented once by feature ID and name in the census; the explicit name filter covers all 168 unique tool names. Canonical inventory has one duplicate name (wait_for), represented as two feature rows.

non_registry_tools_surfaces.name: Browse and manually run extension tools

limits: The canonical inventory also contains 3 separate Tools-surface capabilities (manual runner, Smart tests, Recorder); these are distinct feature rows and are not registered-executor tools. Their absence from the 169-row registry census is scope-correct, not a missing tool binding.
A metadata census cannot establish role availability, request-time filtering, permission decisions, browser behavior, or runtime health.

verdict_b.basis: Counts and uniqueness claims reconcile with the embedded metadata; the raw evidence preserves the query and matching SHA-256, and records definitions, bindings, and both surface rows. Manual-only/registry-drift cases remain explicitly unresolved rather than being labeled defects. Active definition+binding count is 82 by ID intersection; the 2 inactive definition/binding pairs are capture_credential and evaluate_javascript.
limits: The source host is asserted by the operator and the SQL result is supplied as evidence; this verifier did not independently connect to the database or validate host identity.
Reported source checkout SHAs are provenance statements, not independently re-fetched sibling-repository evidence.
No execution or product-health claim is supported by this report.
